role: boss wind-up tell: Raikon's blade tip charging before Thunder Swing and Storm Break
style: stylized anime combat, dark storm stage, one red element
dominant_shape: short red arcs jumping inward onto one point that heats to white, then a star glint

beats.name: gather
beats.expect: Red motes and long red arcs reach in from about a metre out; the tip is only a dim red glow

beats.name: tighten
beats.expect: Arcs are shorter and paler, a broken red crackle ring circles the tip, the core is turning white

beats.name: glint
beats.expect: One white star glint with a cross, a thin red ring and short sparks: the brightest frame

beats.name: clear
beats.expect: Only the last sparks and the ring's fading edge

acceptance: The build visibly tightens: arcs at f6 are long and red, by f30 they are short and near white
Nothing before f36 is as bright as the glint
Motion is inward until the glint, outward only after it
avoid: A glowing ball that only grows
Arcs that fire outward like a hit
A long white hold after the glint
